# Civic Tobacco Machinery

> Civic Tobacco Machinery is a Karachi, Pakistan based supplier of new and reconditioned cigarette and tobacco manufacturing machinery. We supply cigarette making, packing, filter-making, box-wrapping and tobacco handling machines — complete production lines for cigarette and tobacco factories — with installation, spare parts and service. We serve customers across Pakistan and export internationally.

Civic Tobacco Machinery sources, reconditions, installs and supports the machines that run a cigarette factory: makers (Molins Mark 8/9/9.5, Hauni Protos), packers (HLP, SASIB), filter makers (Hauni KDF, Molins PM), over-wrappers and boxers, and the tobacco cutters, feeders, reclaimers and stem flatteners that support the primary and secondary floors. Every used machine is tested and serviced before sale. Prices are quoted on request.

- Business type: Machinery supplier / reconditioner / exporter (B2B)
- Location: Plot No. A, 8/D Fakhruddin Valika Rd, Metroville S.I.T.E., Karachi, Sindh 75700, Pakistan
- Phone / WhatsApp: +92 301 1111184
- Email: info@civic-tobacco-machinery.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 09:00–18:00 (PKT)
- Areas served: Pakistan and international export — Bangladesh, Bulgaria, Poland, Russia, Indonesia, Turkey, Syria, Europe, North America, South America, Australia
- Pricing: Price on request (contact for quotation)

## Cigarette Manufacturing (Making) Machines

- [Cigarette Manufacturing Machines](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-manufacturing-machines/): Molins Mark and Hauni Protos cigarette makers for a range of production speeds and formats.
- [Molins Mark 8 (Post 64)](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-manufacturing-machines/mark-8-post-64/): Dependable maker in Post 64 and MAX-15 configurations, up to ~3,000 cigarettes/min.
- [Molins Mark 8D with MAX-15](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-manufacturing-machines/mark-8d-max-15/): Mark 8D with MAX-15 infeed, up to ~3,000 cigarettes/min.
- [Molins Mark 9.5 with Lenze Servo Drives](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-manufacturing-machines/mark-9-5-lenze-servo-drives/): Mark 9.5 maker with Lenze servo drives and Siemens PLC, up to ~3,500 cigarettes/min.
- [Molins Mark 9.5 with Max S & Tray Filler](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-manufacturing-machines/mark-9-5-max-s-tray-filler/): Mark 9.5 with Max S filter assembler and tray filler, ~4,500–5,000 cigarettes/min.
- [Molins MK-9 with Max S](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-manufacturing-machines/mark-9-max-s/): MK-9 with Max S filter assembler for consistent mid-to-high speed production.
- [Hauni Protos 70](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-manufacturing-machines/protos-70/): High-speed maker up to ~7,000 cigarettes/min.
- [Hauni Protos 80 ER](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-manufacturing-machines/protos-80-er/): High-speed maker up to ~8,000 cigarettes/min for high-volume factories.

## Cigarette Packing Machines

- [Cigarette Packing Machines](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-packing-machines/): HLP and SASIB packers covering hard-pack and soft-pack lines.
- [HLP-180](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-packing-machines/hlp-180/): Double-plunger hard-pack machine for king size, slim and super-slim formats.
- [HLP-200](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-packing-machines/hlp-200/): 200 packs/min with PLC control.
- [HLP-225](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-packing-machines/hlp-225/): 225 packs/min, double-plunger with full PLC control.
- [SASIB 3000 (Soft Pack)](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-packing-machines/sasib-3000/): Soft-pack packing line at steady output.
- [SASIB 5000 (Soft Pack)](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-packing-machines/sasib-5000/): High-speed soft-pack line for larger factories.

## Cigarette Filter Making Machines

- [Cigarette Filter Making Machines](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-filter-making-machines/): Hauni KDF and Molins filter makers for filter rod production.
- [Hauni KDF-1](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-filter-making-machines/kdf-1/): Filter manufacturing machine for consistent filter rod production.
- [Hauni KDF-2](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-filter-making-machines/kdf-2/): High-speed filter maker for consistent rod output at scale.
- [Molins PM-5 Filter Maker](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-filter-making-machines/molins-pm-5/): Filter maker for dedicated filter-rod production lines.
- [Hollow Tube Maker](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-filter-making-machines/hollow-tube-maker/): Machine for consistent hollow-tube filter output.

## Cigarette Box Wrapping & Boxing Machines

- [Cigarette Box Wrapping Machines](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-box-wrapping-machines/): Molins and SASIB over-wrapping, cartoning and box-wrapping equipment.
- [Regular Wrapper CP1](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-box-wrapping-machines/regular-wrapper-cp1/): Pack over-wrapping for hard-pack and soft-pack lines.
- [Naked Over Wrapper](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-box-wrapping-machines/naked-over-wrapper/): Cellophane over-wrapping of finished packs.
- [Molins Boxer](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-box-wrapping-machines/molins-boxer/): Box-wrapping / cartoning machine for finished packs.
- [SASIB Boxer](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cigarette-box-wrapping-machines/sasib-boxer/): Box-wrapping / cartoning at speed for hard- and soft-pack lines.

## Tobacco Cutter, Feeder & Reclaimer Machines

- [Cutter, Feeder & Reclaimer Machines](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cutter-feeder-reclaimer/): Support machines for the primary/secondary floor — feeding, cutting and tobacco recovery.
- [Tobacco Feeder](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cutter-feeder-reclaimer/tobacco-feeder/): Keeps makers fed consistently on high-output lines.
- [Cigarette Reclaimer](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cutter-feeder-reclaimer/cigarette-reclaimer/): Recovers tobacco from rejected sticks for reuse.
- [Hauni Tobacco Cutter KT-400](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cutter-feeder-reclaimer/tobacco-cutters/): Cuts tobacco leaves to size for production.
- [Tobacco Stem Flattener](https://civic-tobacco-machinery.com/cutter-feeder-reclaimer/tobacco-stem-flattener/): Prepares tobacco stems for cutting and blending.
